text:
maya: Weekend question: lazy park picnic + sketching session (2pm) vs neon retro arcade crawl (8pm)? Or both if youre from a different timezone :sunglasses: :joystick:

pete: Park picnic for sure. Ill bring a sketchpad and some bad charcoal. :pencil2:

irene: Arcade!! need to finally beat my high score on Galaxia. :video_game:

sam: Can we do picnic then swing by the arcade? light chill then adrenaline. :slightly_smiling_face:

lucy: If we do both Im in, but heads-up i have a 6pm dentist appt so i might join late. :tooth:

maya: Plan idea: picnic 2-4pm at Harbor Green, then optional arcade meetup 8pm at Neon Alley. Thoughts?

pete: Harbor Green sounds perfect. ill bring a small portable blanket and lemonade. anyone want cheese?

irene: I can bring quarters and a tiny speaker. also a victory playlist for post-high-score dances. :muscle:

sam: @lucy hope dentist is fast! We can hold a spot for you at the arcade.

lucy: Thanks! Ill try to make the 8pm slot. if not, someone send triumphant GIFs. :pray:

calendar-bot: Event created: "Harbor Sketch + Arcade Night" Sat 2:00 PM (Picnic) & 8:00 PM (Arcade)  RSVP: https://calendar.company/events/33133

maya: Quick reminder: please bring sunscreen + water for the park. also label food if it has nuts.

pete: Bringing a little charcuterie and a plant-based dip. labeled, promised. :ok_hand:

irene: GIF: https://giphy.com/galaxia-win.gif :tada:

sam: Vote tally: picnic 2, arcade 1, both 3. Looks like a hybrid weekend is happening. See yall saturday! :confetti_ball:
